desc: Ideation complete: understand problem and plan DP approach.
Define direction vectors and clockwise turn mapping (↘→↙→↖→↗→↘).
Implement DP with memoization for state (i, j, dir, pattern_idx, turn_used), where pattern_idx determines the expected next value (0→2, 1→0).
For each cell with value 1, start exploration in all 4 directions (checking the next cell equals 2), then compute the longest path using DFS with the turn constraint (at most one clockwise 90° turn).
Combine results: for each start, try both "no turn" (straight line only) and "with turn" (max over turn positions along the initial direction), taking the max length.
Handle base case: single cell with 1 gives length 1; if no 1 exists, return 0.
Optimize to O(n*m*4*2*2) DP by processing in reverse order per direction (bottom-up) or use memoized DFS.
Verify the solution against all provided examples and edge cases, and check recursion depth concerns for large grids (consider increasing recursion limit or converting to iterative DP).
Write final solution code in the required class/method format.
